mapper.select: select max(KEY_BATH_NUMBER) from METRO_AGM_KEY_VERSION where PROVIDER_ID = #{providerId} and PUBLIC_KEY_VERSION_STATUS = '20020'

select PROVIDER_ID as providerId, TO_CHAR(KEY_BATH_NUMBER) as currentVersion, PUBLIC_KEY_VERSION_STATUS as status, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updateTime, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as effectiveDate from ( select PROVIDER_ID, KEY_BATH_NUMBER, PUBLIC_KEY_VERSION_STATUS, UPDATE_DATE, REG_DATE, row_number() over (partition by PROVIDER_ID order by KEY_BATH_NUMBER desc) as rn from METRO_AGM_KEY_VERSION ) where rn = 1 order by PROVIDER_ID
